mainEntity.name: What types of flashing are used in stucco re-flashing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Various types of flashing are used in stucco re-flashing, chosen based on the specific application, building code requirements, and desired durability. Common materials include galvanized steel, aluminum, copper, and self-adhering membranes (such as rubberized asphalt or butyl-based products). Metal flashings are durable for directing water, while self-adhering membranes provide excellent seals around penetrations. Often, a combination of materials is used, with a primary goal of creating a continuous, watertight system that integrates seamlessly with the weather-resistive barrier behind the stucco.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco re-flashing uses various materials like galvanized steel, aluminum, copper, and self-adhering membranes, often in combination, to create a watertight seal.
